#!/usr/bin/env python3
# solution for clustering city-year rows into mobility/livability profiles.

import os
import csv
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans

def main():
    # Input file
    input_path = os.path.join("outputs", "t12_selected_matrix.csv")
    df_raw = pd.read_csv(input_path,
                         dtype={"city_id": str, "city_name": str, "year": np.int64, "DE1001V": np.float64})

    # Identify numeric indicator columns
    numeric_cols = df_raw.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()

    # --- Impute missing values with column median (before scaling) -------------
    median_vals = df_raw[numeric_cols].median(skipna=True)
    df_filled = df_raw.copy()
    df_filled[numeric_cols] = df_filled[numeric_cols].fillna(median_vals)

    # --- Standard scaling ----------------------------------------------------
    mean_vals = df_filled[numeric_cols].mean(skipna=True)
    std_vals = df_filled[numeric_cols].std(skipna=True, ddof=0)  # population std to match KMeans in sklearn
    X_scaled = (df_filled[numeric_cols].values - mean_vals.values) / std_vals.values

    # --- KMeans clustering (k=3) --------------------------------------------
    kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10, n_jobs=None)
    cluster_labels = kmeans.fit_predict(X_scaled)

    # --- Write cluster assignment – t13_city_clusters.csv --------------------
    clusters_df = df_raw[["city_id", "city_name", "year"]].copy()
    clusters_df["cluster_id"] = cluster_labels

    out_clusters_path = os.path.join("outputs", "t13_city_clusters.csv")
    clusters_df.to_csv(out_clusters_path,
                       index=False,
                       quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)

    # --- Compute cluster profiles: mean of raw indicator values (ignoring NaNs) ------------
    joined = df_raw.copy()
    joined["cluster_id"] = cluster_labels
    profiles = joined.groupby("cluster_id")[numeric_cols].mean().reset_index()
    profiles = profiles.sort_values("cluster_id")  # Ensure cluster_id order

    out_profiles_path = os.path.join("outputs", "t13_cluster_profiles.csv")
    profiles.to_csv(out_profiles_path,
                   index=False,
                   quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</solution_file>
